summary: Clear enabled-red cron jobs and stale Telegram delivery targets
description: The scheduler is alive with 38 active jobs, but enabled jobs are red: Luca Recruiter exits 1 and Hermes nightly upgrade train blocks at behind=1380. Multiple otherwise-green jobs retain dead Telegram thread IDs and fall back noisily. One paused JSONL ingest remains correctly fail-closed on ledger_runtime_head_mismatch and must stay separately visible.
acceptance: R1 enabled non-green jobs are repaired, intentionally paused with an owner/reason, or moved to their owning repository; R2 dead Telegram thread destinations are pruned after fallback and no longer produce repeated delivery warnings; R3 nightly upgrade train distinguishes expected large fork divergence from actionable upgrade risk and stops emitting the same unresolvable red every night; R4 paused ledger-integrity work remains fail-closed and explicitly reported; R5 a fresh fleet audit reports active_non_green=0 and lists any paused-red jobs separately.
verification: python3 -m pytest tests/cron -q && python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/cron_fleet_health_audit.py && git diff --check
